newsitem.title: USA: USDA plans public hearings on rail merger impact.
newsitem.headline: USDA plans public hearings on rail merger impact.

text.p: The Agriculture Department will hold a series of meetings, beginning in Kansas, to gather information on the impact of rail mergers on rural areas, Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman said Friday.
First hearing will be Wednesday at 1000 EDT/1400 GMT at the Days Inn Dodge House in Dodge City, Kansas. The second will be Thursday at 1000 EDT/1400 GMT at the Holiday Inn-Airport in Wichita, Kansas.
Hearings will be held in other grain states, USDA said.
The Agricultural Marketing Service will conduct the hearings. There are now seven major U.S. railroads, compared to 33 in 1982. The five largest handle 87 percent of freight.
